about: The noise rule's bounds (gates.py; GATES.md 'The run-to-run noise'). A frame two runs disagree on passes as the GPU's run-to-run noise only if every window of the tile pyramid (the 16x16 px tiles' per-channel sums: the largest |difference| of any 1x1, 2x2, 4x4 and 8x8 window of tiles, sliding a tile at a time, and the whole frame's) is within its bound; and, where both runs kept the full frame, every pixel within 1 code and each channel's +1s and -1s within max(small, bal (n+ + n-)) of each other. Each bound is 1.5x the worst seen over F0 run against itself (gnoise.py: work/r1fix/noise1, 2026-11-04: every frame +1..+600 of the settled and plain twins three times at each of the four cases, and three 10-minute flights at d11 and n23; 36,000 frame pairs, 14,186 of them differing), rounded up. Re-derive with tools/gnoise.py OUT --write after any change to the stepping, the GPU or its driver.
lean: How far the noise leans one way, over the calibration's 449 full-frame pairs and F0's own FLIGHT re-runs (gates/r1fix/f0_vs_f0): up to 0.415 of a channel's differing pixels (n23 flight, 208 +1s against 87 -1s), and a frame of 11 with 10 one way (d11 flight); F0 against itself failed FLIGHT on two such frames under the first cut (bal 0.25, small 10/73: d11 +27110 62/36, n23 +5970 97/185). So bal 0.6 and small 16: a spread one-signed change of over 16 px a channel fails, as does one 0.6 or more one-signed; a concentrated one is the tile bounds' (a 16x16 tile at most 17/18).
